checks.name: bootstrap migrates live and historical backups
legacy consumers and service preview still work
save, replace, reveal, redaction and empty env fallback
legacy import and metadata patch retain encryption
fresh nonces, empty and reserved-prefix literals roundtrip
wrong key, tampering, wrong table and unknown versions fail closed
migration atomic failure and cleanup retry
encrypted backups restore and migration is repeatable
key loss refuses replacement even after all credentials removed
invalid backup JSON errors never disclose its contents
unsupported backup files fail closed without replacement
verified exact Finder metadata is preserved while nested legacy backups migrate
disguised or malformed Finder metadata fails with a constant content-free error
metadata-like filenames and data-bearing metadata directories are not exempted
Finder metadata links still fail closed without changing their target
failed staging write closes and removes staging, preserves original and retries
failed staging fsync closes and removes staging, preserves original and retries
interrupted partial and complete staging are discarded, original is migrated
failed staging cleanup preserves original and staging until a successful retry
orphan staging and invalid or unauthenticated originals are preserved
staging directories, unrelated temporary files and legacy names are not deleted
physical database, WAL and backup bytes have no fixture plaintext
process restart with persisted key unlocks saved logins
